more_info.overview: Fatty-acid salts is a group name covering salts made with different metals and fatty-acid preparations. The EU specifications distinguish sodium, potassium and calcium salts from magnesium salts. Their technological functions include emulsifying and reducing caking, depending on the particular preparation and application. Powder, flake and crystalline forms occur in the specifications. The broad E470 label does not identify the metal, fatty-acid feedstock or one uniform commercial product.
